skills.title: Open and close apps
skills.description: Open, focus, or close Windows apps including multi-app close with confirm.

skills.title: Multi-step commands
skills.description: Chain actions with and/then, e.g. open browser, go to YouTube, search Samsung.

skills.title: Web and YouTube search
skills.description: Google or YouTube search; play first/second/third; next/previous video.

skills.title: Type text
skills.description: Type into the focused window, or click-then-type with a countdown.

skills.title: WhatsApp
skills.description: Message a contact or paste clipboard; confirms before send.

skills.title: Gmail
skills.description: Search inbox, summarize unread, compose/send email after OAuth (main.py google-auth).

skills.title: Google Calendar
skills.description: List upcoming events and create meetings after google-auth.

skills.title: Google Drive
skills.description: Search Drive files by name or content.

skills.title: Google Maps
skills.description: Search places and open directions (API key optional; browser fallback).

skills.title: Hotkeys and volume
skills.description: Copy/paste, fullscreen, mute, volume, screenshots from spoken shortcuts.

skills.title: Camera
skills.description: Open Camera, take photo, record, switch photo/video/barcode modes.

cannot: Delete system files or format disks
Send email or WhatsApp without spoken confirm
Use Gmail/Calendar/Drive until you run google-auth
